values.description: Anthropic Claude. Requires aimon-llm-anthropic on the classpath. Assumed when the property is absent.
OpenAI. Requires aimon-llm-openai on the classpath.
Build no LlmClient. The application defines the bean itself; startup fails by name if it does not.
Send no thinking parameter. The default, and the request body an always-on model still thinks under.
thinking: {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": N} - the manual budget dialect.
thinking: {"type": "adaptive"}, with the call's reasoning effort as output_config.effort.
Whichever dialect the capability table says this model speaks; a model it cannot name sends nothing and warns.
Ask the adaptive dialect for a summary of the model's thinking, and stream it. Unset means neither.
Ask the adaptive dialect for short progress updates rather than a running summary, and stream them.
Ask the Responses API to summarise the model's reasoning at a level it chooses, and stream it. Unset means neither.
Ask for a short summary of the model's reasoning, and stream it.
Ask for a fuller summary of the model's reasoning, at a higher token cost, and stream it.
